_comment: SideStep's default AltStore-format app sources. SideStep fetches this list and lets users search across these catalogs. To propose a source, send a pull request adding its URL below. RULES: (1) LEGITIMATE apps only — open-source projects, emulators, official app repos, and EU alternative-marketplace (AltStore PAL) apps. No pirated/cracked/tweaked App Store apps. (2) The source's downloadURL must be a directly fetchable .ipa. Marketplace sources that gate downloads behind auth/DRM (e.g. Epic Games Store, whose .ipa URLs return HTTP 403) do NOT work with SideStep and will not be merged.
_note_eu: EU alternative-marketplace (AltStore PAL) apps that publish a normal .ipa are installable OUTSIDE the EU too — this is a legitimate use of SideStep: Apple is not required to distribute these apps to you, yet you can still sideload them with your own Apple ID.
